fields.value: MAUDE Autoinjectors with Product code KZH Medical Device Report Events

dsDescriptionValue.value: This data note presents valuable insights into reported failures related to autoinjectors, as recorded in the Manufacturer and User Facility Device Experience (MAUDE) database. Autoinjectors play a pivotal role in modern medical treatments, facilitating self-administration of medications. However, understanding the nature of failures and associated risks is essential for enhancing their safety and reliability. By analysing the MAUDE database, this data note sheds light on the types of failures, contributing factors, and potential implications for patient care.

datasetVersion.citation: Marlon Machal et al, 2023,  MAUDE Autoinjectors with Product code KZH Medical Device Report Events, https://doi.org/10.7910/dvn/abe3af
